manifest.description: Inline a Java helper class that has exactly one construction site into its caller, hoisting constructor-assigned fields to locals and removing the helper declaration.
when_to_use: a Method Object or tiny helper class is instantiated exactly once and should be collapsed back into its caller
cleanup after a refactor produced a one-shot class whose execute-style method is now clearer inline
operator has verified the class is not part of a public API and wants a mechanical inline plan
anti_patterns: do not use when the class has multiple construction sites — the plan kind refuses because call-site ownership is ambiguous
do not use when the primary method calls sibling instance methods or depends on private members not representable as constructor-hoisted locals
do not use as dead-code deletion for an unused class — use prune_java_orphans or normal deletion review

source.description: Java file containing the class to inline.

module_name.description: Optional class name; defaults to the first class in source.

impl_name.description: Optional primary method name; defaults to execute or the only method.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-inline-class. Charter: Inline a one-shot Java helper class into its only caller.

Protocol:

1. Ground:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")
   bbox_code_symbols(project_dir="{{project_dir}}", query="{{module_name}}", languages=["java"])

2. Plan conservatively:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="inline_java_class",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      module_name="{{module_name}}",
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}")

   The planner requires exactly one construction site, hoists constructor-assigned fields to caller locals in constructor argument order, rewrites the primary method call, and removes the source class declaration.

3. Refuse on ambiguity:
   - more than one construction site
   - multiple constructors
   - missing constructor assignment for an instance field
   - primary method calls sibling instance methods or uses unresolved members

4. Apply only if requested:
   bbox_refactor_apply(plan_path="<plan_path>", confirm=true)

5. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line: class, caller file, primary method, applied/planned>)

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{module_name}} {{impl_name}} {{apply}}
